title: What a person told ops-preflight about this repo
description: Written by ops-preflight into `<repo>/.claude/ops-preflight-answers.json`, and read by ops-install when it fills in a scaffolded capability. It is a record of what a HUMAN said, kept so nobody has to say it twice. Three rules about it, all load-bearing. It is NOT a 'preflight passed' flag: nothing routes on it, no loop reads it, and ops-install runs the same whether it exists or not. Every answer carries the date it was given, because an answer about a build command is only as good as the day it was said and the reader has to be able to see that. And it is a SUGGESTION, never a fact: ops-install shows an answer back with its date and a person confirms it, rather than filling anything in silently.

version.description: The file's shape. Bump only on a breaking change to it.

answers.description: One entry per question a person actually answered. A check nobody was asked about, or that detection resolved on its own, does not appear: this file records what was SAID, not what was found.

id.description: The check id the question came from, so a re-run can update this answer in place.

consumer.description: The capability this answer is about, straight from the check. This is what lets ops-install pick out the answers that matter while it fills in one capability's stub, with no mapping table to keep in step.

action.description: The action within that capability, where the check names one.

question.description: The question as it was asked, kept verbatim. Without it an answer six months old reads as an orphan.

verdict.description: What the answer resolved to. `unknown` is recorded too: knowing a person looked and could not say is worth more than a blank.

said.description: What the person actually said, in their words. This is the part ops-install reuses: `dotnet build Umbraco.Forms.slnx` is the answer, `present` is only the verdict.

answered.description: The date this answer was given, DD-MM-YYYY. Per answer, not per file, so a re-run that updates three answers leaves the other twenty carrying their own older dates.
